name: Clustered sedge
desc: Clustered sedge (Carex glaucescens): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex glaucescens is a perennial sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. The common name of this sedge is the southern waxy sedge due to the blue-grey, waxy appearance of the sheaths and fruits.
